concepts.name: 코랄 작업실
concepts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: 2D hand-drawn game environment concept art, not a rendered 3D scene.
Input image 1 is the previous scene concept and is ONLY the edit target for its room layout and theme. The user rejected its realistic industrial look. Completely redraw its artistic language, proportions, shading, and painted surfaces rather than merely applying a filter or increasing saturation.
Primary request: recreate this sci-fi maintenance diorama as an unmistakably stylized, beautifully HAND-DRAWN / HAND-PAINTED game environment illustration in the visual tradition of Blizzard World of Warcraft, Hearthstone board environment paintings, and League of Legends stylized environment concept art.
Essential stylistic change: bold chunky exaggerated forms, big readable shapes, gentle irregularity in drawn contours, hand-sculpted oversized bevels, restrained selected contour lines, confident broad brushwork, simple stylized colored shadow shapes, rich hue variation within each large plane, painterly warm edge-light strokes. Heroic cartoon proportions in architecture and machines. Vivid harmonious local color. Everything appears painted by an illustrator with opaque gouache/oil-like digital brushes. It should feel like a Hearthstone environment painting of an industrial workshop, with an almost illustrative clay-like massing, NOT a realistic metal miniature, a polished 3D render, or a realistic military base.
Reduce tiny geometry and micro-detail by 70 percent: replace rows of small bolts with a few oversized stylized bolt heads, realistic grilles with simple broad slot shapes, tiny complicated tools with iconic chunky tools, realistic chipped paint with a FEW expressive brush-painted nicks. Remove dirty mottled noise, corrosion, fine scratched surfaces and realistic reflections. Surface detail comes from authored painted gradients and strokes. Shadows are purple/blue colored masses, highlights are warm creamy painted strokes; no photographic light simulation. Clearly visible hand-painted shape and texture design throughout floor, walls, furniture, tanks.
Keep a spacious open central floor on a raised main deck, L-shaped wall behind it, a workbench and cabinet at the perimeter, cooling/utility wall units, and two thick tanks with curved connecting pipes on the lower foreground deck. Same three-quarter elevated quarter-view composition, wide landscape 3:2, entire room visible on a simple softly painted dark backdrop. Retain this sci-fi cleaning/maintenance-room identity rather than turning it into a medieval tavern or forest. No characters.
Avoid: photorealism, semi-realism, realistic PBR materials, shiny steel, ray-traced reflections, dirty gritty noise, hundreds of little chips, exact CAD-straight machine details, realistic narrow piping, photographic depth of field, bloom-dependent detail, neon cyberpunk, heavy black comic outlines on every edge, text, logos, watermarks, UI, swatch sheets or split-screen.
Palette/theme: punchy but harmonious plum-purple and lavender floor, rich coral-orange worktop and service lane, creamy warm wall insets, saturated periwinkle framing, lilac shadow pools, warm peach painted accents. Deliberately simplify the floor into large uneven beveled panels with sweeping purple brush shading; the service lane is painted broad coral brush bands. Workbench and cabinet have thick rounded exaggerated drawer forms and oversized warm-colored handles. Tanks become squat stout shapes with broad creamy lids and violet shadow masses. Cozy cheerful fantasy-game craft workshop art language translated to sci-fi.
